system.description: Your Web Anchors act as guiding posts for ranged attacks made with a Web Weapon. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack using your Web Weapon, you can choose to target a Web Anchor. If you do, you can then draw a 60-foot long, 5-foot-wide straight line from the Web Anchor in a direction of your choice. All creatures this line crosses must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapons Damage] on a failure, or half as much on a success. This increases to twice your [Weapons Damage] at 11th level.
